|strategy=By Boone Adkins<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040810105653/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/light/small/sonofskywalker.html</ref>

[[Son Of Skywalker]] is a great card. For game players: He is a little bit restricted and costly in deployment, but it’s worth what you get. The power of five is high and an ability of five is good and it allows a battle destiny. Also, that ability allows a good chance for a successful destiny draw for [[Sense]] and [[Alter]]. And last, that ability of five helps with Jedi tests. Now don't be sad about having to deploy only on [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] or Cloud City.

That restriction can be of some use. You can deploy him on [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]], regardless of the location deployment restrictions, a useful thing for Jedi training. Like the typical pilot, [[Son Of Skywalker]] adds two to the power of any starship he pilots. He is immune to attrition less than four. And last, you can deploy a lightsaber to the same location as [[Son Of Skywalker]].

Combos:

[[Son Of Skywalker]] + Any card that allows you to peek at the top of your Reserve Deck - a guaranteed good battle destiny.

[[Son Of Skywalker]] + [[Courage Of A Skywalker]] (In hand) + [[This Is More Like It]] (In hand) + [[Smoke Screen]] (In hand) - Lots of laughs for you, your opponent looses tons of force!

[[Son Of Skywalker]] + [[Chewbacca]] + [[Wookiee Strangle]] + Jedi tests + Apprentice + Lots of [[At Peace]] cards - Now [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] gets choked for a change!

Son Of Sky walker + Teamwork cards and their partners - A heck of a lot of attrition and battle damage

Escorted [[Son Of Skywalker]] + [[Captive Fury]] (Lost function) - Bye Bye [[Bounty]] Hunter!
|combos=* [[Son Of Skywalker]] + Encampment Deploy regardless of location deployment restrictions.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Son%20Of%20Skywalker Scomp: Son Of Skywalker]; card data [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661e). |rulings=* [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] cloud sectors are on [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]], so [[Son Of Skywalker]] may deploy there (but not to the [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] system).<ref name="scomp" />
* [[Bespin]] cloud sectors are ''not'' on Cloud City, so [[Son Of Skywalker]] may ''not'' deploy there or to the [[Bespin]] system.
* In brief: [[Son Of Skywalker]] may deploy to [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] sites, [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] clouds, and Cloud City sites.

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the stat boxes and the deploy and forfeit numbers) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-L-sonofskywalker-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Son Of Skywalker]]: The game text changes: “City, but may move elsewhere.” becomes “City.”; “any starship” becomes “anything”; “during your deploy phase,” is added after “Once per game,”; “here” becomes “on Luke”; “directly” is removed; “Deck. Shuffle, cut and replace.” becomes “Deck; reshuffle.”. The slip shows only the lower part of the card and adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Son Of Skywalker” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
